guide.title: The Guide
guide.intro: Not the cook. The one who tells you what the cook has been up to.
body: Pull up a stool. The cook here is Ritesh. He is in his final year of Data Engineering and AI at Turku University of Applied Sciences. He also works as a student assistant at CoRe, the Cognitive Technologies Research Group at Turku UAS.

He likes the part of machine learning that comes after the demo. Getting a model or a data pipeline to run every day without anyone babysitting it. His thesis predicts prices for used car parts from real listing data.

He speaks Finnish, English and Nepali, and he is learning Swedish. Outside the kitchen he plays football and just ran his first half marathon. Everything on the menu has his hands in it, and the team projects say which part was his. Ask him about any of it.
